note: Shipped provider defaults. TRACKED in git, never written at runtime; data/providers.json (gitignored) is this machine's state and always wins. NOTHING here may name a host other than 127.0.0.1 — a LAN/Tailscale endpoint is machine state, not a shipped default. `seed` is instantiated into data/providers.json on first boot and three-way merged on upgrade; `kinds` is the detection registry: which loopback ports to probe and with which probe.
